title: Antiquities
description: Adds new relics using the Relique plugin
body:
--- ## Requirements: The plugin requires [AbyssalLib](https://modrinth.com/plugin/abyssallib) and [Relique](https://modrinth.com/plugin/relique) ## Features Antiquities is a plugin based on [Relique](https://modrinth.com/plugin/relique/) and adds 9 Relics that fit well into vanilla. ### Items: - Blaze Ember Ring: inflicts fire on target (requires either unarmed or an unenchanted tool) - Echoing Circlet: causing blindness and glow effect on hit target - Membrane Cowl: phantoms ignore you - Piglin Signet: piglins ignore you - and more... The plugin also adds advancements for all the relics. ---

Relics
